description_en: Queries the monitoring data of an Elastic Container Instance (ECI)
description_zh: 调用DescribeContainerGroupMetric查询一个ECI实例的监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun eci describe-container-group-metric --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --container-group-id eci-bp17da5olmkuagfr0000 --start-time 2019-03-12T01:00:00.000Z --end-time 2019-09-12T01:05:00.000Z --period 15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeContainerGroupMetric

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECI instance. This is the container group ID
parameters.name: container_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query. The value must be within the last 30 days. The default value is 5 minutes before the value of EndTime.

The time is in the RFC3339 format. For example, 09:00:00 on March 12, 2019 (UTC+8) can be represented as 2019-03-12T09:00:00.000+08:00 or 2019-03-12T01:00:00.000Z
parameters.help_zh:
查询某个时间段内的监控数据时，设置的开始时间。取值必须为30天之内，默认为EndTime减去5分钟。

格式为RFC3339时间格式。例如：北京时间2019年03月12号上午9点整可以表示为2019-03-12T09:00:00.000+08:00或者2019-03-12T01:00:00.000Z
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The default value is the current time.

The time is in the RFC3339 format
parameters.help_zh:
查询某个时间段内的监控数据时，设置的结束时间。默认为当前时间。

格式为RFC3339时间格式
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The aggregation period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 15, 30, 60, and 600. Default value: 60.

> If you do not set StartTime and EndTime, the monitoring data of the last 5 minutes is queried. The default aggregation period is 15s, and the Period parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh:
数据聚合周期，单位为秒。目前只支持15、30、60和600秒。默认为60秒。

> 如果StartTime和EndTime均没有设置，则默认获取最新5分钟的监控数据，默认聚合周期为15S，传入的Period将被忽略
parameters.name: period
